Checks authentication, channels, sharing, knowledge sources, transcripts, and testing against the agent's target environment and data class. docs.description: Governance review posture: read-only by default, findings tied to the item they came from, evidence over opinion

Use when reviewing access, identity, secrets, or connector policy on a Power Platform environment, or when answering "who can reach this", "is this data exposed", "do we need a DLP exception". Produces a security finding set for one environment or one solution, each tied to the item it came from. Activate for security review, DLP review, access audit, least-privilege check, or secret-handling question.
ECDX Power Platform practices: environments, ALM, naming, security and a release checklist

Use when planning a Power Platform change, or when an existing solution starts to matter more than it used to. Works out which environment it belongs in, what class of data it touches, and therefore which controls apply. Activate for "what process applies", "how much ALM do we need", "can we skip documentation", "is this critical", or before any Power Platform scaffolding.

docs.description: Use before releasing a Power Platform solution, when auditing one already in production, or when reviewing someone else's work. Walks the ECDX release checklist that applies to the target environment and criticality, reporting what you found and what it would cost. Activate for "is this ready to ship", "review this solution", "what is missing before release", "run the checklist", or "audit this environment".
